Length.description: Points as a number, a token such as "10mm" or "2.5cm", or { value, unit }.

Color.description: A palette token ("slate-800") or a hex colour ("#1e293b", "#rgb", "#rgba", "#rrggbbaa").

Spacing.description: A length, [horizontal, vertical], [left, top, right, bottom], or per-side lengths.

Border.description: A width, { width, color }, or per-side widths with an optional colour.

PageSize.description: A named size or { width, height } in points.

FontWeight.description: A weight token or a number from 1 to 1000.

TextDecoration.description: One decoration, or several to combine ("none" cannot be combined).

Permissions.description: "all", "none", one permission, or a list of them.

DateTime.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.

ChartNumberFormat.description: G, F<n>, N<n> or P<n>, with n from 0 to 15.

IntegerOrUnlimited.description: A whole number of at least 1, or "unlimited".

StackChild.description: An element, or { element, weight } to give it a share of a weighted row.

ListItem.description: A string, or a nested list of the same type as its parent.

TableCellNode.description: Text, an element, or a cell with options of its own.

TableRowNode.description: An array of cells, or an object with options and cells.

Resource.description: Bytes are referenced (`ref`, supplied by the host) or embedded (`data`).

Element.description: An element node. `type` selects one of the catalogue elements.
